description: Step 2 capability ownership map. Core code lives in vertical modules; Laravel delivery/integration remains outside module cores.

Access.purpose: Authorization, collaborator grants and SQL visibility policies.

CloudDrive.purpose: Connected external drive lifecycle and provider adapters.

DirectUpload.purpose: Provider-direct upload sessions, signing and finalization.

Download.purpose: Download orchestration across package and connected-drive storage.

Media.purpose: Authoritative media lifecycle, metadata, comments and media persistence.

Processing.purpose: Media processing, derivatives and asynchronous processing jobs.

Sharing.purpose: Share lifecycle, download constraints and share URL ports.

Storage.purpose: Filesystem abstraction, placement, lifecycle and orphan cleanup.

Trust.purpose: Inspection, scanning, quarantine and delivery trust policies.

Workspace.purpose: Workspace identity, resolution and workspace-scoped read models.

Shared.purpose: Minimal shared kernel for cross-capability errors and Eloquent mechanics; must not accumulate feature behavior.
